title: Virtual Shareholder Meetings
authors: François Brochet; Roman Chychyla; Fabrizio Ferri
eligible_reason: Determinants (logit/OLS on VSM adoption), matched-sample comparisons, transcript-feature regressions and event-window returns. The only DiD (Tables 7 and 8 Panel E, diff_in_diff_sample.dta) is a two-period pre/post comparison around the forced 2020 COVID switch: 145 treated vs 129 control firms, one pre and one post meeting each, estimated as difference of means (rc_stats.diff_diff_reg) or reg y treatment post treatment_post + time-varying controls + FF12 dummies, no firm FE. Single common adoption date; pooled treated dummy instead of unit FE.
design_notes: Python/Stata/SAS. Voluntary VSM adopters pre-2020 are analyzed cross-sectionally (matched to in-person meetings), not as a staggered panel. COVID-forced VSMs in 2020 give a single treatment date.

ineligible_specs_listed.location: Table 7 Panels A-D; Table 8 Panel E
ineligible_specs_listed.reason: two-period DiD around the common 2020 forced switch; pooled treatment dummy, no firm FE; Panel E adds time-varying controls

data_files_note: README (docx): input datasets for all tables shipped; raw WRDS/Capital IQ extraction code provided but needs subscriptions.
screener_notes: Software mix: Python (statsmodels), Stata, SAS. Not a staggered design.
